append.detail: 2026-11-09 retirement scan: the original patch (f6dd66168) naming the eight modules is not in the repo, so I scanned components/ and lib/ for navigation, menu, rail, dock, header, footer and tab modules that nothing imports. One is truly dead: components/frequency/members/route-tabs.tsx (33 lines, no importer, test or probe); it is deleted here. The other candidates are live (lib/nav/prefetch-fuse.ts is installed from instrumentation-client.ts, lib/nav/marker-cookie and the two rewrite modules from proxy.ts, marketing-header/footer from app/page.tsx), or are guard targets (admin-rail-drawer-column, header-offset). Seven of the eight retirements are still unidentified, so the row stays OPEN. 2026-11-09 (owner approved each pin rewrite by name): deleted components/spaces/spaces-toolbar.tsx and lib/nav/my-frequency-rows.ts with their pins edited (the check-vocab entry; nav-coverage.test keeps the four My Frequency destinations as data so the coverage check is unchanged), and dropped the now-unused export on MyFrequencyEntry to hold the dead-export ceiling. components/spaces/dashboard/space-dashboard.tsx and components/admin/admin-rail-drawer-column.tsx were deleted then RESTORED: no component imports either, but six closed rows (SCAN-600, LIVE-431, HYG-121, LIVE-476, LIVE-504, LIVE-513) carry probes that read them, and the full probe sweep (check:backlog --probes=all) failed on all six. Retiring them means first re-pointing those probes, and the admin rail mask the probes expect (data-visual-mask="admin-rail") lives only in the unused file, so the real admin rail may be unmasked: a separate finding. lib/layout/header-offset.ts was approved for deletion but kept: it is the LIVE-492 detector, not an unused module. Retired with route-tabs: three of eight; five still unidentified or probe-pinned, so the row stays OPEN.
